The child successfully completed the task by following these steps, and the caregiver praised their careful execution.

The child initially considered watering the plants or opening the shears but did not know the correct sequence of actions. The caregiver clarified the steps: put on gloves first, retrieve the pruning shears from the toolbench, then trim only the overgrown branches before closing the shears. The task succeeded as the child followed the guided steps to complete the pruning.
  3. The task is to measure 1 cup of granulated sugar using a measuring cup for cookie dough, categorized as cooking/baking. The child was unsure how to accurately measure the sugar and whether to use additional tools, struggling with the technique of leveling. The caregiver explained to fill the measuring cup to the 1-cup line and use the back of the knife or spoon to level off the excess, ensuring an exact measurement; the task succeeded as the child followed these instructions correctly.
